name: Motherson Yachiyo Automotive Tech Products of America, Inc.
old_description: As a world-class manufacturer of automotive parts, Motherson Yachiyo of America is committed to meeting every expectation of our customers. Our specialty is designing and producing plastic fuel tanks and sunroofs. At every turn, we work to improve our processes as we achieve the ideal outcome for our customers.
about:
Motherson Yachiyo Automotive Tech Products of America, Inc. operates from Columbus, Ohio. The business became part of the Motherson group in 2024, extending a track record as a Tier 1 automotive supplier that dates back to 1997. No founders are named in public records.

The company designs and manufactures plastic fuel tanks and sunroofs, with sunroof production described as its flagship operation. An Ecoat (electrodeposition) coating line handles steel (galvannealed or zinc-plated) and aluminum parts, with a tunnel opening of 3 by 4 by 3 feet. The firm also offers sub-assembly services to simplify customers’ workflows. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Its customer base is the automotive industry, where it serves as a Tier 1 supplier. No specific OEMs or programs are identified in the available information.

The company states that it works to improve processes continuously to meet every customer expectation, emphasizing the quality and cost-effectiveness of its Ecoat line and the efficiency gains from its sub-assembly offering.
